svg.title: Balanced sample board with resource symbols and distinct ports
svg.desc: Sixth-edition fixed frame, rotated for this top-down display: six separately outlined pieces, matching connector numbers 1–6, and nine ports assigned to the verified physical pieces. Each port marks its two coastal endpoints. Original schematic outlines simplify manufactured puzzle joints. Terrain symbols refer to the shared legend.
